description: LLM-as-judge that scores N candidate outputs against a rubric in ONE pass. Pairs with `InferenceProviderABTestComponent` (upstream) to close the 'should we go local' loop with a quality signal. Optional `min_winner_score` asset check makes the pair a branch-deploy merge gate.

outputs.description: One asset with per-candidate scores, winner alias, delta vs. baseline, judge cost/latency. Optional `winner_meets_threshold` asset check.

include_reasoning.label: Include Reasoning
include_reasoning.description: Reasoning models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, ...) inline <think>...</think>. The thinking is always stripped; when true it is also returned as a 'judge_reasoning' key on the output dict (distinct from the per-candidate 'reasoning' the judge writes into scores).

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the emitted asset (holds per-candidate scores + winner).

candidates.label: Candidates
candidates.description: Upstream asset keys to score. Multi-part keys use slash notation. Each candidate's text is loaded from the standard {text, content, ...} shape.

rubric.label: Rubric
rubric.description: Scoring rubric. Shapes: {kind: literal, text: '...'} | {kind: file, path: '...'} | {kind: url, url: '...'}. Include specific criteria + point weights.

judge.label: Judge
judge.description: Judge model config: {model, api_key_env_var, [api_base_env_var, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens]}. Use a strong model — gpt-4o or claude-3-5-sonnet — since the judge sets the ceiling on evaluation quality.

min_winner_score.label: Min Winner Score
min_winner_score.description: 0-100. When set, emits an asset check `winner_meets_threshold` that fails ERROR when the winner's score is below this. Branch-deploy merge gate.

baseline_alias.label: Baseline Alias
baseline_alias.description: Optional baseline candidate alias for delta metrics.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated string OR list for static/multi.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Provider A/B Evaluator
